newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Large bullish trade seen in BT.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Large bullish trade seen in BT.

text.p: One single institutional investor amassed a huge position in British Telecommunications calls late in the session on Tuesday, dealers said.
More than 5,000 February 390 calls were bought on BT. It was by far the biggest trade of the day in stock options, but dealers said they did not know the source of the deal.
The calls will be profitable if BT shares, up 2-1/2p to 359-1/2p at 1506 GMT, rise to 395 before December expiry.
"It looks like a straight bullish trade," said one broker.
In total, some 5,550 BT options traded by 1506 GMT.
Volatility in at-the-money FTSE 100 options tumbled as the underlying index rallied on Tuesday and open interest shifted into November 3,950 calls and puts, dealers said.

The shift in open interest into the 3,950 strike price, they said, suggests options traders are betting that the blue chip index, up 16.0 points to 3,930.4, will add another 20 points before the November contract expires on Friday.
Volatility, especially on the puts, had been creeping higher in recent days, while open interest was building in the 4,000 and 3,900 strikes before today's rebound, they said.
